summary: Improve partner planning, pipeline reviews and channel-conflict decisions. Explore this five-day strategic channel management course.
lede: Channel management training helps channel managers and partner-facing sales professionals coordinate indirect sales coverage and partner activity. It covers assessing coverage gaps, segmenting and selecting partners, and turning joint business plans into owned actions. Participants also practise reviewing partner pipelines and forecasts, documenting deal-registration decisions, and setting rules of engagement to manage account-ownership conflicts.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who own indirect sales execution or coordinate the people and work products that keep partner relationships commercially active.
prerequisites: Prior work with channel partners, indirect sales or partner-facing commercial activity is expected. You should be comfortable reviewing basic sales and partner records; no coding or programming is required.
